o1: Enables GTPase activating protein binding activity and ankyrin repeat binding activity. Predicted to enable GTPase activity. Involved in endocytic recycling and receptor-mediated endocytosis. Is located in early endosome; plasma membrane; and recycling endosome membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including intestine. Is part of the receptor-mediated endocytosis pathway. Orthologous to human RAB35 (RAB35, member RAS oncogene family).
